title: Key version — Key associations
bodyMarkdown:
## Purpose

Key version in Key associations: The selected key-version metadata. It is not the key value or a workload handle; inspect exact association/grant version before use.

## Constraints and permissions

Create/edit is available only in the permitted synthetic presentation/state. A hidden or disabled action must not be bypassed. The declared input is text; the exact submit-time checks remain with the renderer and current state. This help does not invent additional numeric limits or identity rules. Use only synthetic non-secret data.

## Expected result

Inspect the value in the `#/operator/associations` table/details or an allowed dialog. A successful preview edit changes browser-local demonstration state only; it does not charge, authenticate, send a ticket, move a key, dispatch a device or execute a service command.

## Recovery

Cancel the dialog to keep the preceding record. If a field or permission error appears, correct the intended field/context and review again instead of widening role/scope. Read-only, loading, empty or error presentations are not proof that a real backend action succeeded. Use the accounts, discovery and administration guide for the complete safe journey.
capabilityStatus: Synthetic browser record field only; not a live account, provider, billing, key, ticket or service operation.
